conviction_note: SUPN is no longer a standalone stock: both shareholder votes passed on 2026-10-15, the all-stock merger closes 2026-11-02, and SUPN trades at parity with 1.5401 x (INDV - $8.13 special dividend) (41.31 vs 41.21 implied at 14:14 ET today). So the window is in effect the combined company's last pre-close session. The Q3 print reaches the price only through Supernus's ~43.5% share of combined value. Indivior already printed this morning (before the window) and the Zurzuvae line is already public from Biogen's 10-28 release. abs_move_pct 2.5 is about one daily sd of SUPN's 36.8% realised vol plus some event premium, because Khattar becomes CEO of the combined company and may speak to it on tonight's call. p_up 54 is a slight lean from the Zurzuvae step-up and Indivior's strong quarter, pulled toward 50 because both are public and inside guidance. The findings sum to +0.30 and the scaled number is +0.20; they are close, and both are small by construction of the peg.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue about $219-221M from three aggregator snapshots that roughly agree: Benzinga EN $221.3M (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/SUPN/earnings-forecasts), Benzinga KR $218.8M updated 10-23 (https://kr.benzinga.com/quote/SUPN/earnings-forecasts), and StockAlarm $219M avg, range 218-221 (https://pro.stockalarm.io/quote/SUPN/analysts). positioning_check: No usable option chain (baseline: unusable_chain, total OI 9, skew null), so the market makes no directional statement. Latest dated short interest found is FINRA 2026-06-30, about 7.1M shares, 6.96 days to cover, 0.4% borrow fee (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/supn/, updated 2026-07-14); Equibles shows 4.72M shares, 8.54 DTC at 2026-04-30 (https://equibles.com/stocks/supn/shortinterest). findings.finding: Biogen's Q3 2026 release (10-28) puts ZURZUVAE net revenue at $84.4M, against $70.8M implied for Q2 (Supernus booked $35.4M as its 50% share in Q2). That makes Supernus's Q3 collaboration revenue about $42.2M, +$6.8M q/q. Holding the rest of Q2's $219.1M flat would give about $226M, against a ~$219-221M consensus and the ~$216-232M per quarter the FY guide implies.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On SUPN's real prints, Q2 2026 beat revenue ($219.1M vs ~$205M est per EarningsWhispers snippet) with a raised guide, but that day (+3.07%) was dominated by the merger announcement. Q1 2026 (+4.59%) and Q4 2025 (+5.67%) were up and Q3 2025 was -17.35%. Since the 08-03 peg, a SUPN revenue surprise reaches the price only at ~43.5% weight of the combined company.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus snapshots predate Biogen's 10-28 release (KR Benzinga updated 10-23). If the market had repriced it, SUPN would have outperformed the INDV-implied parity on 10-28/10-29. It did not: 41.08 vs 41.03 implied on 10-28 and 41.31 vs 41.21 on 10-29. But that ratio is pegged by the arbitrage, so it could not show it either way. The number is public and inside guidance; the residual unpriced part is small.
findings.independence: Q2 release confirms the 50% share and Q2 $35.4M (https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/supernus-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial-results); Biogen 10-Q $84.4M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000875045/000087504526000096/biib-20260930.htm), which is the same company source, not independent.

findings.finding: SUPN is a pegged merger-arb instrument for the whole window. Both shareholder votes passed 2026-10-15. Closing is expected 2026-11-02 at a fixed 1.5401 INDV shares per SUPN share. Indivior's $8.13 special dividend (record date 2026-10-30) goes to pre-close INDV holders only. At 14:14 ET today SUPN was 41.31 against 1.5401 x (34.885 - 8.13) = 41.21, a ~0.2% premium. So SUPN's move over the window equals the ex-dividend combined company's move, and Supernus's own print carries ~43.5% weight in it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior SUPN print under a peg. Daily SUPN/parity deviation over 10-16..10-29 stayed within about +/-0.5% (e.g. 10-22: 42.07 vs 41.89 implied).
findings.why_not_priced: This is not mispricing; it is a scale fact. A judge sizing SUPN on its standalone reaction history (median 3.3-5% on real prints) would oversize it by roughly 2x. The sign is neutral.
findings.independence: Exchange ratio, 43.5/56.5 split: DEFM14A (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001356576/000110465926107109/tm2625197-1_defm14a.htm). Dividend $8.13, record 10-30, Supernus holders excluded: Indivior 8-K ex99-1 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001625297/000110465926108417/tm2623753d7_ex99-1.htm). Votes 10-15: Supernus 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001356576/000135657626000040/supn-20261015.htm). Prices: Yahoo chart (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/SUPN?range=1mo&interval=1d, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/INDV?range=1mo&interval=1d).

findings.finding: Indivior, which holds 56.5% of the combined company SUPN converts into, reported Q3 2026 this morning: revenue $356M (+13%), SUBLOCADE $267M (+22%), adjusted EBITDA $211M (+76%). Nine-month EBITDA of $562M against an unchanged FY guide of $700-740M implies only $138-178M for Q4, a conservative standalone guide that lapses at the 11-02 close. INDV was +0.33% intraday by 14:14 ET.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: INDV moved +0.33% on the print day by 14:14 ET (34.77 -> 34.885); there is no other INDV reaction history in the record.
findings.why_not_priced: Most of it is priced: the release came at 07:00 ET today, before the window opens at today's close. The residual is that the market may read the Q4 run-rate gap as sandbagging once the combined company (CEO Khattar) speaks, possibly on SUPN's call tonight. If that were priced, INDV would have moved more than +0.3% on a +76% EBITDA quarter.
findings.independence: Same document as the second finding for the merger facts; the EBITDA and revenue numbers are only in this release. Pro forma $888M adj EBITDA and $125M synergies: barchart merger story (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/4132785/supernus-pharmaceuticals-and-indivior-pharmaceuticals-to-merge-creating-a-diversified-cns-biopharmaceutical-leader-with-significant-scale).

findings.finding: S&P DJI announced on 2026-10-22 that Huron Consulting replaces SUPN in the S&P SmallCap 600 effective before the open on 2026-11-02. Any deletion trade sits at the 10-30 close, the last close of this window. INDV is already an S&P 600 member, so index funds can take INDV shares via the merger rather than sell, and arbitrage against INDV caps any SUPN-specific dislocation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None for this name; INDV's own S&P 600 addition in Dec 2025 is the only index event on record and its reaction was not sourced.
findings.why_not_priced: It is announced and largely priced. The residual is closing-auction pressure on 10-30 if some trackers sell SUPN rather than await conversion; that would show as SUPN closing below INDV-implied parity on 10-30.
findings.independence: S&P press release (https://press.spglobal.com/2026-10-22-MSG-Rangers-and-Huron-Consulting-Group-Set-to-Join-S-P-SmallCap-600). Same announcement, not independent.

outside_window.finding: Merger closes 2026-11-02 and the combined Supernus, Inc. trades as SUPN from 2026-11-03. The $8.13 INDV special dividend is paid ~11-06 and funded partly by a $650M term loan, which adds combined-company leverage. A first combined-company guide or synergy update could land at or after close.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with, and the run-up is flat. The slight positive lean (Zurzuvae step-up, strong INDV quarter) is public information on a stock pegged by arbitrage to INDV, so it cannot be much mispriced; the evidence mostly says the move should be smaller than SUPN's own history suggests.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (inside the guide) and rule 1 (fact is not reaction): Zurzuvae finding cut from +0.40 to +0.25. The implied Q3 lands inside the FY-guide quarterly range and the number has been public via Biogen since 10-28.
Rule 3 (own caveat reaches the number): Indivior Q3 finding cut from +0.30 to +0.15, because its own why_not_priced says it was released before the window opened.
